# Strathprints - University of Strathclyde Institutional Repository

> > Strathprints is the University of Strathclyde's open access research repository, providing access to peer-reviewed publications, theses, and research outputs across science, engineering, law, and interdisciplinary fields.

The repository showcases research from the Faculty of Science, Strathclyde Law School, and other departments, featuring work by notable researchers including D.J. Higham in numerical methods and computational mathematics, P.J. Halling in biocatalysis, and legal scholars Alison Cleland and Jane Scoular. Collections span computational science, materials chemistry, photocatalysis, polymer science, and Scottish family law.

## Key Topics

- Numerical methods and stochastic differential equations
- Scientific computing and computational mathematics
- Biocatalysis and enzymatic synthesis
- Photocatalysis and semiconductor photochemistry
- Polymer chemistry and branched polymers
- Scottish family law and children's rights
- Runge-Kutta methods and defect control
- Free radical polymerization
- TiO2 films and self-cleaning materials
- N-heterocyclic carbene complexes
- Monte Carlo methods in finance
- Children's hearings system
- Solid-to-solid synthesis
- Micro-LED technology
- MATLAB and MAPLE for scientific computing

## Numerical Methods & Computational Mathematics

- [An algorithmic introduction to numerical simulation of stochastic differential equations](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/174): Higham's algorithmic guide to SDE simulation with MATLAB programs
- [Black-Scholes for scientific computing students](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/162): Higham's educational guide to Black-Scholes and Monte Carlo methods
- [Numerical simulation of a linear stochastic oscillator with additive noise](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/164): Higham's study on stochastic oscillator numerical simulation methods
- [Runge-Kutta defect control using Hermite-Birkhoff interpolation](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/208): Higham's work on Runge-Kutta defect control for numerical methods
- [Global error versus tolerance for explicit Runge-Kutta methods](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/206): Higham's analysis of error-tolerance in Runge-Kutta solvers
- [MAPLE and MATLAB for stochastic differential equations in finance](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/216): Higham & Kloeden on computational tools for financial SDEs

## Photocatalysis & Materials Science

- [Self-cleaning titania films: an overview of direct, lateral and remote photo-oxidation processes](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/463): Mills et al. overview of self-cleaning titania photo-oxidation mechanisms
- [Spectral and photocatalytic characteristics of TiO2CVD films on quartz](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/422): Mills et al. study on TiO2 CVD films photocatalytic properties
- [Light-driven oxygen scavenging by titania/polymer nanocomposite films](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/451): Xiao, Mills et al. on UV-driven oxygen scavenging nanocomposites
- [A web-based overview of semiconductor photochemistry-based current commercial applications](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/420): Mills & Lee's review of commercial semiconductor photocatalysis applications
- [Two-photon fluorescence imaging of gallium nitride micro-LED arrays](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/47): McConnell et al. on two-photon imaging of GaN micro-LED technology

## Polymer Chemistry & Synthesis

- [Facile synthesis of branched poly(methyl methacrylate)s](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/506): Isaure, Cormack & Sherrington on branched PMMA polymer synthesis
- [Use of rapid triple detection size exclusion chromatography to evaluate the evolution of molar mass and branching architecture during free radical branching copolymerization of methyl methacrylate and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/537): Saunders, Cormack et al. on SEC analysis of branching copolymerization
- [Synthesis of zirconocene amides and ketimides and an investigation into their ethylene polymerization activity](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/608): Henderson et al. research on zirconocene catalysts for polymerization
- [Reactions of (imidazol-2-ylidene)silver(I) chlorides with group 4 metal containing Lewis acids](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/588): Kennedy et al. on silver N-heterocyclic carbene complex reactions

## Biocatalysis & Enzymatic Synthesis

- [Enzymatic solid-to-solid peptide synthesis](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/254): Research on enzymatic peptide synthesis by Erbeldinger, Halling et al.
- [Biocatalysis in reaction mixtures with undissolved solid substrates and products](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/321): Ulijn, Halling et al. on enzymatic reactions with solid substrates

## Scottish Family Law & Children's Rights

- [Child-centred family law practice](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/620): Cleland & Hall-Dick's book on child-centred family law practice
- [Children's Voices](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/627): Cleland & Scoular's chapter on children's voices in Scottish family law
- [Perspectives on the children's hearings system](https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/764): McDiarmid & Scoular on children's hearings and Human Rights Act
